services.title: How I can *help*

items.title: Product & UX design
items.body: Turn a complicated workflow into a product people can finish without help.
items.get: Research, user flows, wireframes and high-fidelity UI for web and mobile.

items.title: Interactive prototypes
items.body: Test the real experience before launch. Your users and stakeholders click through it like the finished app.
items.get: A fully interactive prototype on real devices, ready for user testing and sign-off before development.

items.title: Design + front-end code
items.body: No handoff gap: the design arrives as working code.
items.get: React or React Native front end built from the design, ready for your engineers to connect.

items.title: Design system & Figma library
items.body: Every screen delivered on a system your team can keep building with.
items.get: A Figma file with tokens, components, variants and documentation, organised for handoff.

items.title: Arabic & English products
items.body: Arabic designed from the start, not translated and flipped at the end.
items.get: RTL layouts, Arabic type pairing and mirrored interactions across your product.

items.title: Design workflow consulting
items.body: Help your team design faster, with fewer surprises at handoff.
items.get: A review of your design process, tools and handoff, with a clear plan, including where AI saves real time.

services.intro: Bring me in for one piece or for the whole product. Every engagement ends with something your team can use.

process.title: From problem to *product*
process.intro: A clear process, so you always know what happens next.

steps.name: Discover
steps.body: Understand your users, business rules and constraints before drawing anything.
steps.example: SalesPoint: mapped KYC, activation and approval rules across roles and operators.

steps.name: Define
steps.body: Turn what we learn into a clear problem, user flows and structure.
steps.example: Multi-stage, role-based approvals reduced to flows each role can follow.

steps.name: Design
steps.body: From wireframes to polished UI, built on a system so it stays consistent.
steps.example: 200+ screens on shared components and tokens.

steps.name: Test
steps.body: Compare options side by side and choose with evidence, not opinion.
steps.example: 12 competing variants tested: 5 activation flows, 5 credit-limit patterns, 2 migration models.

steps.name: Build & hand off
steps.body: Hand over specs, tokens and components, or build the front end myself.
steps.example: Components reviewed and approved before they enter the library.

contact.title: Let's build something *clear.*

aboutPage.title: About
intro: I'm Hamza, a senior UI/UX and product designer in Amman, Jordan. I've spent four years making complex telecom platforms simple enough for daily, high-volume use.

I own the UX and the design system of SalesPoint, one dealer platform running across five operators. I also build what I design, in React and React Native, and use AI tools to get from concept to a near-production prototype quickly.

how.title: How I think
items: Systems before screens: one set of components that adapts to many brands.
Make the complex simple: clear flows for KYC, activation, billing and approvals.
Decide with evidence: I compare variants side by side.
Lead through standards: design-system governance and review before components enter the library.

items.body: Promoted from UI/UX Designer. UX and design system owner for SalesPoint; design-system governance; coordinating design priorities across the team.

why.title: Why teams work *with me*

items.b: SalesPoint runs across five operators on one system, with light and dark themes, Arabic and English, and brand switching. Each new operator launched on existing components.
KYC, SIM activation (physical and eSIM), billing, ownership transfer, wallets, commissions and multi-stage approvals, turned into clear flows for daily use.
I don't guess. I tested 12 competing variants side by side: 5 activation flows, 5 credit-limit patterns and 2 migration models.
I've shipped 9+ apps end to end in React and React Native, and use AI tools to get from idea to a near-production prototype fast.
I run design-system governance, set the standards other designers build on, and coordinate design priorities across the team.
